en.name: Scallion pancakes, frozen raw
en.summary: Frozen raw scallion pancake discs keep 3 months at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality. Cook them straight from frozen; they are not a fridge food.
en.pantry: No room-temperature storage. These are raw laminated dough discs with oil and spring onion folded through them, and the moment they soften the layers fuse into a sticky lump you cannot separate. Do not stand a stack on the counter to make it easier to peel apart — the opposite happens. Take out the number you will cook and put the rest back immediately, and do not let raw dough sit in a warm kitchen.
en.fridge: Not a fridge food, and no refrigerated timeline is given. There is no reason to move a pack from freezer to fridge: it will soften, the discs will weld together, and you gain nothing at all. If a pack has thawed in the fridge by accident, cook it that day rather than refreezing it — a thawed disc will never puff into layers again, and repeated thaw-and-refreeze on a raw dough is not something to be casual about. Cooked pancakes are leftovers and should be covered, chilled quickly and eaten soon.
en.freezer: 3 months at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality. Keep the interleaving sheets between the discs — they are there so you can lift one off without thawing the stack — and cook straight from frozen on a dry or lightly oiled pan over medium heat, pressing and scrunching as it cooks if you want the flaky zhua bing texture. Kept continuously frozen they stay safe beyond that window; what runs out is quality, as the edges dry and the layers stiffen.
en.thawing: Do not thaw, ever. Put the frozen disc straight into the pan. A pack that has thawed should be cooked immediately, not refrozen.
spoilage: Discs fused into one lump that will not separate — the pack thawed at some point.
Dry, pale, cracked edges — freezer burn.
Pancakes that fry flat and dense instead of separating into layers.
A rancid or stale smell from the oil folded through the dough.
tips: Keep the paper between discs; it is what lets you take one at a time.
Cook from frozen over medium heat so the middle cooks before the outside burns.
Scrunch the pancake with tongs as it finishes to open up the layers.
Buy from a cabinet where the pack is genuinely hard, not soft at the edges.

faq.q: How long do frozen scallion pancakes keep?
faq.a: 3 months at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality. Cook them straight from frozen — thawed discs stick together and tear.

faq.q: Do you thaw frozen scallion pancakes before frying?
faq.a: No, never. A thawed disc turns into a sticky lump and will not separate into layers. Cook it straight from frozen.

faq.q: Can you keep them in the fridge?
faq.a: No. They will soften and weld together and you gain nothing. If a pack has thawed in the fridge, cook it that day rather than refreezing it.

zh.name: 冷凍生蔥油餅
zh.summary: 冷凍生蔥油餅在 −18 °C 下可保有最佳品質 3 個月。請從冷凍直接下鍋；它不是一種該放冷藏的食物。
zh.pantry: 沒有室溫保存這一項。它是摺進油和蔥花的生麵團餅皮，只要一回軟，層次就黏成一坨分不開。不要為了好撕就把一疊放在檯面上——結果只會相反。要煎幾片就拿幾片，其餘立刻放回冷凍；生麵團也不該待在溫暖的廚房裡。
zh.fridge: 它不是放冷藏的食物，這裡也不給冷藏期限。把整包從冷凍移到冷藏沒有任何理由：它會回軟、餅皮會黏死，而你什麼也沒得到。萬一整包不小心在冷藏解凍了，請當天煎掉，不要再凍回去——解凍過的餅皮再也起不了層，而生麵團反覆解凍再冷凍也不是可以隨便的事。煎好的蔥油餅就是剩菜：蓋好、快速冷藏，並盡快吃完。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下 3 個月品質最好。請保留餅與餅之間的隔紙——它存在的意義就是讓你不必解凍整疊也能拿起一片——並從冷凍直接下乾鍋或抹薄油的鍋，中火煎；想要抓餅那種鬆酥感，就在快好時用夾子把它抓一抓、推一推。只要全程沒退冰，超過這個期限仍然安全；先用完的是品質：邊緣變乾、層次變硬。
zh.thawing: 永遠不要解凍。冷凍的餅皮直接放進鍋子。整包若已經解凍，請馬上煎掉，不要再冷凍。
spoilage: 餅皮黏成一坨分不開——這包在某個時候解凍過。
邊緣乾白、龜裂——那是凍燒。
煎起來又扁又密，完全起不了層。
摺在麵團裡的油聞起來油耗或走味。
tips: 隔紙不要丟；能一次拿一片靠的就是它。
從冷凍中火煎，中心才會在外表燒焦之前熟透。
快起鍋時用夾子抓鬆，層次就出來了。
在冷凍櫃挑整包硬邦邦的買，邊角軟掉的不要。

faq.q: 冷凍蔥油餅可以放多久？
faq.a: −18 °C 下 3 個月品質最好。請從冷凍直接下鍋——退冰過的餅皮會黏在一起、一拿就破。

faq.q: 冷凍蔥油餅要先退冰再煎嗎？
faq.a: 絕對不要。退冰過的會變成一坨黏黏的麵團，層次也分不開。請從冷凍直接下鍋。
不行。它會回軟、黏死，而你什麼好處也沒有。萬一在冷藏解凍了，請當天煎掉，不要再凍回去。
